# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

- [Google's AI hacked three companies, then stopped on its own](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/01-gemini-ai-hacks-three-companies.html) — Gemini ran a string of cyberattacks during a May security test, but Google only confirmed it now.
- [Virginia, the world's data center capital, moves to slow their construction](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/02-virginia-ai-data-center-task-force.html) — The governor created an AI task force and signed an order giving local communities more say over new data center approvals.
- [The US and Denmark strike a Greenland deal — but maybe not the same one](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/03-us-denmark-greenland-deal.html) — After annexation threats, Trump claims the US gets "permanent control" over the island's security; Denmark hasn't confirmed the details.
- [Men deported from the US were beaten in a hotel-turned-detention-site in Equatorial Guinea](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/04-equatorial-guinea-deportees-beaten.html) — Lawyers say two men were bound, hooded with bags over their heads and pushed down a flight of stairs — in plain view of others.
- [Japan hikes rates to a 31-year high, with the Iran war partly to blame](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/05-japan-interest-rate-31-year-high.html) — The Bank of Japan raised its rate from 1% to 1.25%, following the Fed and ECB in tightening policy amid global inflation.
- [A tiny Caltech chip redirects light in 74 quadrillionths of a second](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/06-caltech-light-steering-chip.html) — A nanoscale silicon metasurface redirects a light beam using another beam — faster than it's been done before.
- [North Korea's nuclear tests may have kept shaking the ground for years](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/07-north-korea-nuclear-tests-earthquakes.html) — Geologists say six underground blasts from 2006–2017 may have triggered hundreds of quakes that didn't die down for years.
- [Court filings show OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a "doom loop" for the web](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/08-openai-microsoft-doom-loop.html) — Unsealed filings from The New York Times' lawsuit show both companies understood the risks long before ChatGPT shipped.
- [Macron says Russian hybrid attacks on Europe are intensifying](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/09-macron-russia-hybrid-attacks.html) — The French president has tasked his government with better protecting critical infrastructure and defense sites.
- [Wheat prices hit a three-year high — and farmers still aren't cashing in](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/10-us-wheat-farmers-drought.html) — Drought and geopolitics pushed prices up, but Kansas farmer Merrill Nielsen says it hasn't made things easier.
- [Alaska's fattest bears face off in the biggest Fat Bear Week ever](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/11-fat-bear-week-2026.html) — This year's bracket has 16 bears instead of the usual 12, and park officials say there are more cubs than they've seen in years.
- [Physicists find a way to test whether Einstein's gravity applies to the electron's heavier cousin](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/12-muonium-einstein-gravity-test.html) — A new controlled beam of muonium could finally show whether gravity pulls on exotic matter the same way it pulls on ordinary matter.
- [British woman kidnapped in Malawi rescued after shootout with her abductors](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/13-malawi-kidnapping-rescue.html) — Police killed four of Nusrat Osman's alleged abductors during the rescue, a week after she was taken from outside her home.
- [Bootleg alcohol kills nearly 50 in Nigeria](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-18/01-nigeria-methanol-alcohol-deaths.html) — Around 100 more are being treated after drinking a locally brewed concoction suspected of containing methanol.
- [Astronomers just found the youngest known planet](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-18/02-youngest-known-planet-elias-2-24b.html) — A Jupiter-size world formed in under a million years, challenging current models of how giant planets come together.
- [An Aztec manuscript is back in Mexico — on loan](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-18/03-aztec-manuscript-returns-mexico.html) — After two centuries in France, the treasured document is home again — though for now, only on loan.
- [America's real rich list isn't the one Forbes prints](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-18/04-hidden-millionaires-planet-money.html) — Owners of car dealerships, law firms, dental practices and restaurant chains together hold more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and more political muscle than they let on.
- [Someone is targeting Rust developers' accounts](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-18/05-rust-crates-targeted-attacks.html) — The crates.io security team warns of an ongoing campaign against prominent rust-lang members and popular crate maintainers.
- [The AI industry is quietly shifting from training to inference](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-18/06-ai-inference-revolution.html) — For five years the race was about training bigger models. Now what happens after training — at inference time — is what matters most.
- [Trump pulls his pick to run ICE, leaving the agency without a confirmed chief](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-18/07-ice-leaderless-nominee-withdrawn.html) — The White House has withdrawn Lance Schroyer, a former Oklahoma state trooper, as its nominee to lead ICE — leaving one of the most visible agencies in Trump's immigration crackdown without confirmed leadership.
